messages.subject: Idea: 4-day work week pilot - super excited about this
messages.body:
Hi Ingrid!

So I keep seeing companies our size moving to a 4-day week and honestly I think we could be a poster child for it - we already have people working remotely ~40% of the time, and employer branding-wise this would be AMAZING for the two engineering roles we're about to open. Imagine the job posting: 'Ship v3, keep your Fridays.'!

I put together a few slides on how it could work (same pay, same hours compressed, Fridays off): [deck - 6 slides, '4-day week @ Parcelwise']

Would love to explore this together! Chloe

messages.subject: RE: Idea: 4-day work week pilot - super excited about this

sounds good on paper. right now everything is about shipping v3. let's revisit after launch.
